<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Behind her mother, Kelsa nodded. “Don't push yourself too hard. If they shame you too badly, I'll pay them back in the Iron trials.”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|— ''Unsouled'', chapter 9}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Kelsa Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Kelsa, also known as Wei Shi Kelsa, is a tall, athletic, and intense [[sacred artist]] belonging to the [[Wei clan]]. A practitioner on the [[Path of the White Fox]], she utilizes light and dream-based [[madra]] to create illusions, such as the [[Fox Dream]] or [[Fox Mirror]], and can manifest [[Foxfire|foxfire]]. She is noted for her exceptional discipline and skill, having reached the [[Iron stage]] at only sixteen years old—a feat far ahead of most [[sacred artists]] in her clan. Throughout her progression, she has advanced through various ranks, including [[Copper]], [[Iron]], [[Jade]], [[Gold]], and [[Truegold]], eventually reaching the [[Lowgold]] level. Kelsa is characterized by her directness, neatness, and intense focus. She is the sister of [[Lindon]] and the daughter of [[Wei Shi Jaran]] and [[Seisha|Wei Shi Seisha]]. Her journey involves significant combat experience, ranging from training with her brother to fighting against members of the [[Kazan]] and [[Jai]] clans, as well as facing threats from the [[Heaven’s Glory School|Heaven's Glory School]]. She has demonstrated resilience in the face of hardship, including periods of deprivation and the emotional toll of family struggles. In her later developments, she has utilized various [[constructs]] and [[security scripts]] to aid in her survival and combat effectiveness.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Kelsa is a tall and broad individual. She has been seen wearing orange shadesilk training clothes with a copper scepter badge, a plain gray [[sacred artist's robe]], or a stony [[The mask|mask]]. At times, she has also been observed wearing a large backpack and covered in ash and dust.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Kelsa is typically bold and direct when she speaks. She shows protective tendencies toward her brother, [[Lindon]], by advising him against overexertion and threatening those who would shame him. However, she has also been seen displaying a hollow expression while answering questions or huddling in fear.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A practitioner of the [[Path of the White Fox]], Kelsa cultivates light and dream [[aspects]] using [[White Fox|White Fox madra]]. Her techniques include the [[Foxtail Enforcer]], [[Fox Dream]] for creating illusions, and the [[Fox Dream Ruler]]. In combat, she utilizes [[Foxfire]], a buckler shield that expands from her forearm, and an invisible [[sword]] maintained through a combination of [[wind]] and [[madra]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Wei clan youth}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Kelsa is the sister of [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c2">''Unsouled'', chapter 2</ref> A [[sacred artist]] on the [[Path of the White Fox]], she cultivates [[aspects]] of light and [[dreams]] while wearing orange shadesilk training clothes and a copper badge marked with a scepter.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c5">''Unsouled'', chapter 5</ref> After reaching the barrier between [[Copper]] and [[Iron]] at age sixteen, she was on the verge of condensing [[Iron]] as a [[Copper stage]] practitioner.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c5" /><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c6">''Unsouled'', chapter 6</ref> She eventually advanced to the [[Iron stage]] and became the highest-ranking young [[Iron]] in the [[Wei clan]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c7">''Unsouled'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c12">''Unsouled'', chapter 12</ref> Kelsa warned [[Lindon]] not to push himself too hard and threatened to repay anyone who shamed him during the [[Iron]] trials.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c9">''Unsouled'', chapter 9</ref> During [[Lindon]]'s visions, she is seen kneeling and crying in his dream.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c10">''Unsouled'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c11">''Unsouled'', chapter 11</ref> She sat next to [[Lindon]] in the stands and watched the arena match with horror.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c11" /><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c12" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Lowgold of the Wei clan}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|As the youngest and strongest [[Lowgold]] of the [[Wei clan]], Wei Shi Kelsa has served as a teacher who has exclusively trained [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15">''Dreadgod'', chapter 15</ref> During an encounter with [[Jai Long]], Kelsa utilized a [[Striker technique]] alongside the [[Foxtail Enforcer]] to launch an attack with [[Foxfire]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17">''Dreadgod'', chapter 17</ref> Following this, Kelsa and [[Jai Chen]] huddled together in fear.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref> Later, Kelsa appeared with a hollow expression while wearing a stony [[The mask|mask]] to answer questions for a family.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref>}}
